ABOUT.PARAGRAPH1: Frédérique Ventos has always devoted herself to figurative collage alongside her career as a legal professional. Her recent works explore the world of outsider art, reflecting a more critical and clear-eyed perception of the contemporary world.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH2: Her sensitivity to words also led her to edit books on poetry bibliophilia, attesting to her attachment to literature.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH3: Over the years, she has built a collection focused on contemporary figuration – including paintings, prints, and drawings: Rustin, Pierrakos, Socquet, Balthus, Pastor, Ludo Godot, Delvaux, Pouppeville, Peccolo...
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH4: She participated in a group exhibition at Galerie Scène Intérieure in Paris in 2018 and held a solo exhibition at Giverny in Tournai in 2017. Her collages are part of several private collections.
